raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`attention_config.indexer_sparse_logits` (#56254) lets DeepSeek-V4.1's candidate-consuming indexer layers score only the candidate blocks with DeepGEMM's sparse MQA-logits kernels instead of dense logits over the whole context. Today it requires the MXFP4 indexer cache (`indexer_kv_dtype="mxfp4"`), so with the default FP8 cache the flag fails at startup:

```
ValueError: attention_config.indexer_sparse_logits requires the MXFP4 indexer cache
```

The restriction dates from before #61149: the FP8 cache then stored one fp32 scale per token, while the sparse kernels take UE8M0-packed (granularity-32) scales. Since #61149, the SM100 FP8 indexer cache stores each token's power-of-two scale as four equal UE8M0 bytes, which is exactly the MXFP8 layout DeepGEMM expects, and DeepGEMM's sparse kernels already have an FP8 (`float_e4m3_t`, `SM100_MMA_MXF8F6F4_SS`) variant for both the contiguous (prefill) and paged (decode) paths. Its paged accessor reads the same page layout as vLLM's FP8 cache (`PAGE_KV x 128` value bytes, then `PAGE_KV` uint32 scales).

This PR wires the FP8 cache into the existing sparse path, so the decode speedup no longer requires trading the K cache down to 4 bits.

## Results

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4, 4x B300, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --no-enable-prefix-caching`, greedy decoding. Decode and prefill throughput from a linear fit of wall time against output length (256 / 1024 / 2048 output tokens), each point run twice

| batch x context | decode tok/s MAIN | decode tok/s PR | decode speedup | prefill tok/s MAIN | prefill tok/s PR | prefill speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 64 x 8K | 6,459 | 6,584 | 1.02x | 124,569 | 126,088 | 1.01x |
| 32 x 100K | 3,920 | 4,117 | 1.05x | 117,066 | 117,774 | 1.01x |
| 16 x 256K | 2,293 | 2,535 | 1.11x | 103,739 | 104,733 | 1.01x |
| 8 x 512K | 1,301 | 1,399 | 1.08x | 85,609 | 87,355 | 1.02x |
| 4 x 1M | 692 | 745 | 1.08x | 62,604 | 63,967 | 1.02x |

Decode improves at every point, with up to 11% higher decode throughput. Prefill is at parity: decoder SWA bounded replay (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58132) runs the candidate-consuming layers on only each request's last 128 tokens during prefill, so little prefill indexer work is left for the sparse path to remove.

<details>
<summary>Serving matrix (request stream, 1024 output tokens, 4 x concurrency prompts)</summary>

Median TPOT is lower with the flag on in 29/29 points (1.01-1.10x, median 1.03x) and output throughput is higher in 28/29 (median 1.02x); prefill-only TTFT at concurrency 1 is at parity (0.99-1.04x) from 4K to 1M. No short-context regression: 4K and 16K are 1.01-1.06x on TPOT.

| ISL | conc | TPOT p50 off / on (ms) | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4K | 1 / 64 | 4.15 / 4.07, 13.27 / 12.68 | 1.02x, 1.05x |
| 64K | 1 / 16 | 4.23 / 4.14, 10.92 / 10.40 | 1.02x, 1.05x |
| 128K | 1 / 16 | 4.25 / 4.13, 16.64 / 15.34 | 1.03x, 1.08x |
| 256K | 1 / 16 | 4.27 / 4.09, 26.83 / 24.81 | 1.04x, 1.08x |
| 512K | 1 / 16 | 4.35 / 4.08, 55.51 / 50.43 | 1.07x, 1.10x |
| 1M | 1 / 8 | 4.37 / 4.12, 59.44 / 57.47 | 1.06x, 1.03x |

</details>

## Accuracy (gsm8k)

MAIN:

```
Results:
Accuracy: 0.901
Invalid responses: 0.000
Total latency: 32.481 s
Questions per second: 40.609
Total output tokens: 122187
Output tokens per second: 3761.825
```

PR:

```
Results:
Accuracy: 0.908
Invalid responses: 0.002
Total latency: 31.403 s
Questions per second: 42.002
Total output tokens: 121786
Output tokens per second: 3878.109
```

+def _quant_k(x: torch.Tensor, kv_dtype: str):
+    """Quantize [N, D] rows as the indexer cache stores K.
+
+    Returns (values, packed UE8M0 scales [N] int32, dequantized fp32). MXFP4
+    packs D/2 bytes (viewed as int8) with one scale per 32 elements; FP8 is
+    e4m3 with one power-of-two scale per row, stored as four equal UE8M0
+    bytes (the SM100 FP8 indexer cache layout)."""
+    if kv_dtype == "mxfp4":
+        from vllm.third_party.deep_gemm.utils import cast_back_from_fp4
+
+        fp, sf = _quant_fp4(x)
+        deq = cast_back_from_fp4(fp, sf, gran_k=32, use_packed_ue8m0=True)
+        return fp.view(torch.int8), sf.view(-1), deq.float()
+    amax = x.float().abs().amax(dim=-1).clamp(min=1e-4)
+    exp = torch.ceil(torch.log2(amax / 448.0)).to(torch.int32)
+    scale = torch.exp2(exp.float())
+    values = (x.float() / scale[:, None]).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    ue8m0 = ((exp + 127).to(torch.int64) * 0x01010101).to(torch.int32)
+    return values, ue8m0, values.float() * scale[:, None]
+
+
+def _quant_q(x: torch.Tensor, kv_dtype: str):
+    """Quantize [N, D] Q rows as the indexer passes them: MXFP4 like K, or
+    FP8 e4m3 with unit UE8M0 scales (FP8 Q folds its scale into the weights,
+    see ``mqa_logits_mx_inputs``)."""
+    if kv_dtype == "mxfp4":
+        return _quant_k(x, kv_dtype)
+    values = x.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    unit = torch.full((x.shape[0],), 0x7F7F7F7F, dtype=torch.int32, device=x.device)
+    return values, unit, values.float()
+
